title: Oscar Night
intro: [excited] Roll out the red carpet and polish those golden statues, because tonight is OSCAR NIGHT! Disney's greatest Academy Award moments... [chuckles] and I promise my acceptance speech will be short. Ish.

art.prompt: A glamorous Hollywood awards night: a sweeping red carpet under golden searchlights, velvet ropes, a sea of camera flashes, a towering abstract golden statuette silhouette and a sealed envelope on a silver tray, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Adventure Is Out There!
categories.intro: [excited] Our film tonight won TWO Oscars and made everybody cry in the first ten minutes. It's Up!

art.prompt: A colorful house lifted into the sky by thousands of rainbow balloons, floating above a misty South American waterfall and flat-topped mountains at sunset, a grape soda bottle cap pin in the foreground, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Carl ties thousands of these to his house to fly it to South America.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is balloons! [laughs] Pixar's animators figured it would take millions to really lift a house. Details, details.

clues.clue: This eager young Wilderness Explorer stows away on Carl's flying house, hoping to earn his last badge.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Russell! [chuckles] Assisting the elderly badge: EARNED. And then some.

clues.clue: This lovable golden retriever wears a collar that lets him talk.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dug! [excited] I have just met you, and I love you. SQUIRREL!

clues.clue: Up won the Oscar for Best Original Score for this composer, who also scored Ratatouille and Coco.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Michael Giacchino! [sighs] His waltz Married Life is basically a box of tissues in musical form.

clues.clue: Up was only the second animated film nominated for Best Picture, after this 1991 film.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! A tale as old as time, and a nomination for the ages.

categories.title: Golden Statues
categories.intro: [whispers] The envelope, please... It's Disney's history at the Academy Awards!

art.prompt: A row of gleaming golden award statuettes on a marble stage under a spotlight, with velvet curtains, an open envelope and drifting golden confetti, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: With 22 competitive Oscars, this man holds the record for the most Academy Awards won by one person.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Walt Disney! [excited] Twenty-two competitive wins, plus four honorary awards. Walt's trophy shelf needed its own zip code.

clues.clue: This 2003 movie about a clownfish dad was the first Pixar film to win Best Animated Feature.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Finding Nemo! [laughs] Fish are friends, AND fish are Oscar winners.

clues.clue: This 2013 film was the first from Walt Disney Animation Studios to win the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen! [chuckles] It also won Best Song. The Oscars just could not let it go.

clues.clue: This star won Best Actress for her very first film role, as Mary Poppins.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Julie Andrews! [excited] First movie, first Oscar. Practically perfect in every way.

clues.clue: This 1988 mix of live action and cartoons won three competitive Oscars, plus a special award for its animation director, Richard Williams.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Who Framed Roger Rabbit! [laughs] P-p-p-please, give it up for the bunny.

categories.title: Red Carpet Close-Ups
categories.intro: [mischievously] Each of these scenes comes from a Best Animated Feature winner. We start REALLY zoomed in. Buzz in as soon as you recognize it!

art.prompt: A paparazzi camera lens extreme close-up reflecting a red carpet and golden searchlights, with a magnifying glass and film reel nearby, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This zoomed-in scene comes from a Best Animated Feature winner. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Encanto! [excited] A magical house, a miracle candle, and a family that needs therapy. In a good way.

media.prompt: A colorful magical Colombian family home in the mountains with glowing doorways, yellow butterflies, a flickering candle in a window and tiles that ripple like waves, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this Oscar-winning city. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zootopia! [laughs] A city with a tundra, a rainforest AND a desert. Pack layers.

media.prompt: A futuristic city skyline split into icy tundra towers, a misty rainforest district and a sunny desert district, with a tiny carrot-shaped pen recorder on a train platform, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this Oscar-winning headquarters. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Inside Out! [sighs] Those memory orbs are just the cutest little feelings.

media.prompt: An endless maze of tall shelves holding glowing colored memory orbs in yellow, blue, red, green and purple, inside a vast dreamlike mind landscape, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this Oscar-winning skyline. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Hero 6! [excited] San Fransokyo, the city where the windsocks are koi fish. Hairy baby!

media.prompt: A futuristic hybrid city of steep hills and cable cars with pagoda-style rooftops, a red suspension bridge with gateway-shaped towers and koi-fish wind turbines floating in the sky, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this Oscar-winning landscape. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Brave! [whispers] Follow the wisps... they lead you to your fate. Or to a bear. Usually a bear.

media.prompt: A misty ring of ancient standing stones in the Scottish Highlands, glowing blue will-o-the-wisps floating among them, a torn family tapestry and a longbow on a mossy rock, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

categories.title: Award-Winning Rides
categories.intro: [chuckles] Oscar winners don't just sit on a shelf. They get their own RIDES. Let's tour the parks!

art.prompt: A glittering theme park boulevard styled like old Hollywood at twilight, with a pagoda-roofed movie palace facade, golden searchlights, a spinning cartoon taxi ride and a giant chef's hat sculpture, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: At Hollywood Studios, Mickey and Minnie's Runaway Railway is inside a replica of this famous Hollywood movie palace.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Chinese Theatre! [excited] Where countless stars pressed their handprints in cement out in Hollywood. Mine would just be a smudge.

clues.clue: This Oscar-winning rat's trackless 4D ride is in EPCOT's France pavilion.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Remy's Ratatouille Adventure! [laughs] You get shrunk down to rat size. Finally, a ride where I'm the right height.

clues.clue: Toy Story 3 and Toy Story 4 both won Best Animated Feature. This themed land opened at Hollywood Studios in 2018.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story Land! [chuckles] Everything is giant, because YOU are the toy. Watch out for Andy's sneakers.

clues.clue: Roger Rabbit's Car Toon Spin is a spinning dark ride in this Disneyland land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey's Toontown! [mischievously] Just avoid the dip. Trust me on this one.

clues.clue: Zootopia, the 2016 Best Animated Feature winner, got its own full themed land in December 2023 at this park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Shanghai Disneyland! [excited] The world's first Zootopia land. Please do NOT let Flash run the ticket booth.

categories.title: Short and Golden
categories.intro: [excited] Not every Oscar winner is feature-length! Let's celebrate Disney and Pixar's award-winning SHORTS.

art.prompt: A cozy miniature movie theater with a tiny glowing screen, a stack of short film reels, a toy one-man-band drum, a chessboard, a steamed dumpling and a seashell on velvet seats, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Pixar's Oscar-winning short Bao, a lonely mom's homemade dumpling turns into one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a baby boy! [sighs] I cried, then got really hungry. Classic Pixar combo.

clues.clue: Pixar's Oscar-winning short Geri's Game shows an old man playing this game against himself in a park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is chess! [laughs] Geri later showed up in Toy Story 2 as the toy cleaner. Busy guy.

clues.clue: Pixar's 2016 Oscar-winning short Piper follows a baby of this kind of shorebird.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a sandpiper! [excited] The feathers were so realistic, people asked if it was live action.

clues.clue: This 1988 short about a one-man-band toy was the first Pixar film to win an Oscar.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tin Toy! [chuckles] That terrifying drooly baby helped inspire Toy Story. Thanks, baby.

clues.clue: This 1937 Silly Symphony, the first film to use Disney's multiplane camera, won the Oscar for Best Cartoon.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is The Old Mill! It won the cartoon Oscar AND a technical award for the camera itself.
